items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Well, you have, then again you have Milton Baptiste, Joe Butler, Wallace Johnson. And the guy that plays guitar, I just know him by the name of Joe, I don't know his last name, and myself.

ctx.x: How many guys in the second line?

Six of us. And who are they? Well, you have, then again you have Milton Baptiste, Joe Butler, Wallace Johnson. And the guy that plays guitar, I just know him by the name of Joe, I don't know his last name, and myself. It's a, we have rock and roll jobs. It's somewhat comical you know. Well I performed with June Gardner before James Black. These are big jazz concerts where you have to read music for this. The guys you would call you about a week or two weeks before the concert and just put that music in front and…
Can you play modern jazz solos?
